title: JEFF Configuration
description: Configuration for JEFF agent workspace manager.

gig_home.description: Override gig home directory. Empty uses default (~/.gig/).

repos.description: Registered codebases. Keys are short names (e.g. 'backend').

description.description: Human-readable description of the repo, injected into agent context.

base_branch.description: Base branch for worktrees and PRs. Default: origin/main.

branch_name.description: Script that outputs branch name. Receives task JSON on stdin.

post_setup.description: Script run after worktree creation. Receives src_dir and dest_dir as args.

hooks.description: Hook name to enabled state. Null/missing map means all enabled.

checkpoint_patterns.description: Regex patterns matched against Bash commands. When a command matches, the agent is nudged to run jeff checkpoint.

skip_permissions.description: Launch agents with permission prompts disabled (default true). Set false to keep native permission prompts; --safe overrides per run.
